name: A material vocabulary
art: Use site/assets/atelier/specimen-cabinet.webp as the original material-quality baseline. A new set must be coherently art-directed and detailed enough to inspect.

properties.label: Six-specimen editorial cabinet
properties.text: Use a carefully photographed cabinet of six material specimens as the main field, balanced by restrained editorial type and a small selected-specimen description.

properties.label: Coherent material collection
properties.text: Treat the grid as an actual collection in which each object has its own surface vocabulary, coherent scale, contact shadow, fine edge and enough resolution for microstructure comparison.

properties.label: Quiet museum-drawer labels
properties.text: Keep labels quiet and precise, like a museum drawer.

properties.label: Six distinct surface vocabularies
properties.text: Combine warm chalk, stone, glass, metal and softer organic textures under one consistent studio light.

properties.label: Keyboard-equivalent specimen detail
properties.text: Each specimen button opens a large detail dialog with a material name and specific description. Escape and close return to the cabinet; touch and keyboard inspection are equivalent.

properties.label: Consistent enlarged crop
properties.text: Preserve the same original lighting and crop in the enlarged view.

properties.label: Material distinction check
properties.text: Every specimen must differ in roughness, transmission or structure rather than hue alone. Compare image crops and selection behavior at all target sizes.
